xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: 1) As on 30th June 2026, the total number of accounts belonging to Promoter(s) & Promoter(s) Group have been clubbed to 82 on the basis of their first names and PAN in Table II. 2) Entities and individuals forming part of "Promoter(s) & Promoter(s) Group" but holding NIL shares as on 30th June 2026 have been included in Table II. 3) Name of the individuals and entities forming part of Promoter(s) & Promoter(s) Group, including the details of Karta and Trustees are based on the name reflecting in their demat account or basis the disclosure received from them. 4) Late Mr. Abhay Arvind Vakil, Late Mr. Amar Arvind Vakil, Late Mrs. Chandanben Chhotalal Shah and Late Mrs. Asha Subash Gujarathi still holds the shares of the Company in their respective demat account(s). Accordingly, they have been disclosed as part of the Shareholding Pattern. 5) Voting rights on shares transferred to Investor Education and Protection Fund and Unclaimed Suspense Account are frozen. Voting rights on 6,800 equity shares of the Company of shareholders currently lying in the Suspense Escrow Demat Account of the Company are not frozen as per SEBI Master Circular dated 6th February 2026. 6) Shareholding details provided under the heading "Other Directors / Relatives" at point no. (m) of Public - Non-Institutions section is with respect to the shareholding of Independent Directors and their relatives. 7) Shareholding details provided under the heading "Unclaimed or Suspense or Escrow Account" at point no. (m) of Public - Non-Institutions section is with respect to the shares transferred by the Company in the Unclaimed Suspense Account and Suspense Escrow Demat Account opened pursuant to SEBI Regulations and Circulars issued thereunder. 8) As per SEBI Circular dated 30th June 2022, categorization and disclosure of each shareholder category is required to be carried out in the order prescribed in the above format. Accordingly, if a shareholder is falling under more than one category, then the same has been classified in the category falling first in the order prescribed in the above format. 9) Sub-categorization of shares under column no. (XIX) will be based on shareholding (no. of shares) under the following sub-categories: (i) Shareholders who are represented by a Nominee Director on the Board of the Company or have the right to nominate a representative (i.e. Director) on the Board of the Company. (ii) Shareholders who have entered into shareholder agreement with the Company. (iii) Shareholders acting as persons in concert with Promoter(s). 10) As the voting rights on the shares held by Employee Benefit Trust under SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021 are frozen, Barclays Wealth Trustees India Private Limited, Designated Trustee of Asian Paints Employees Stock Ownership Trust will not vote in respect of the shares held by them. 11) Asian Paints Employee Stock Option Plan 2021 is currently implemented through secondary market route, hence, there is no effective diluted paid-up share capital of the Company on account of ESOPs granted. 12) Details of Significant Beneficial Owners disclosed as part of the said Shareholding Pattern in terms of the SEBI Circular dated 7th December, 2018, read with the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules, 2018, is based on the disclosures received. 13) Three individuals viz. Ms. Nysha Rupen Choksi, Mr. Hrishav Varun Vakil and Ms. Nyra Varun Vakil, being part of Promoter(s) & Promoter(s) Group of the Company and acting together are SBOs based on the disclosures received from them and in terms of the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules, 2018. However, they have not been considered as SBOs for the purpose of disclosure in Web Form BEN-2 as they are minors and the form does not allow inclusion of their names. Accordingly, in the same lines they have not been included here. 14) The Board approved limits have been mentioned as 100% based on the limit as applicable to companies under Manufacturing Sector as per the Foreign Exchange Management (Non-debt Instruments) Rules, 2019 made under the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999.
